name: Candy Crush Saga
desc:
Switch and match Candies in this tasty puzzle adventure to progress to the next level for that sweet winning feeling! Solve puzzles with quick thinking and smart moves, and be rewarded with delicious rainbow-colored cascades and tasty candy combos!
Plan your moves by matching 3 or more candies in a row, using boosters wisely in order to overcome those extra sticky puzzles! Blast the chocolate and collect sweet candy across thousands of levels, guaranteed to have you craving more!

name: Crossy Road
desc: Crossy Road is a mobile game that was released on November 20, 2014. It was developed by the indie company Hipster Whale and developers Andy Sum, Matt Hall, and Ben Weatherall. The name and concept of the game is a play on the joke Why did the chicken cross the road?

name: Disney Crossy Road
desc:
"Why should the chicken get all the fun?"
From Hipster Whale, the makers of the original Crossy Road with over 120,000,000 downloads, and Disney comes Disney Crossy Road, an all-new take on the 8-bit endless adventure to cross the road without splatting! Tap and swipe your way to a record-setting number of steps with 400+ Disney and Pixar figurines while dodging crazy and unexpected obstacles in 8-bit worlds!
COLLECT over 400+ Disney and Pixar figurines (many with fun surprises)!
JOURNEY through 8-bit depictions of iconic locations while enjoying 8-bit versions of familiar tunes!
MASTER special themed challenges unique to each of the worlds and then some!

name: Drakons Realm Keepers (multiguns)
desc: Soar on a gigantic dragon, shoot enemies, and conquer new realms in this thrilling, high-flying ride from Adrenaline Amusements, Drakons: Realm Keepers. Fun for two players, feel the high-flying excitement of riding a dragon while facing off against dark magic. Engage in epic boss battles that have you holding on for dear life as you embark on an exhilarating journey through mystical worlds. “Drakons: Realm Keepers” delivers heart-pounding action and breathtaking visuals, making it a must-play for all adventure seekers and dragon enthusiasts. Get ready to unleash your inner hero and become a legendary Realm Keeper in this epic fantasy adventure!

name: Flappy Tickets
desc: Flappy Tickets is a video game with ticket redemption feature included. Players fly through various obstacles and try to win tickets.

name: Fruit Ninja FX2
desc: Slice fruit, don’t slice bombs – that’s all you need to know to get started with the addictive Fruit Ninja action!

name: Hot Wheels Victory Lap
desc: This game looks like a NFS Heat reskin on the whole. This is a little surprising as the train of thought was previously that it’d be based more on one of the Hot Wheels home games, but instead Adrenaline took a different approach. That part is fine by me, and it does at least look pretty sharp graphically; although like NFS (and also their recent Drakons), free continues are not offered, instead requiring players credit in again whether they win or not. While this design choice is nothing new (games as far back as the likes of Star Wars Battle Pod have been doing it) that is always a controversial feature among arcade game fans. Doubly disappointing is the apparent lack of a high score table, though that isn’t surprising either as Adrenaline’s other recent games haven’t had those too.

name: Hot Wheels: King of the Road
desc: Hot Wheels: King of the Road is a fun multiplayer driving game developed by Coin Crew and Adrenaline Amusements. As the name implies, the challenge is to be the “king of the road” by reaching the end first and collecting as many coins as you can along the Hot Wheels track along the way. Drive one of six real Hot Wheels cars, choose from one of the three tracks, then go, Go, GO! Staying true to the Hot Wheels theme, the multi-lane tracks include ramps for catching big air, loop-de-loops and plenty of obstacles that can get in the way of reaching the end first. Each race is a blast of chaotic fun, as the cabinet was designed to handle up to six players at a time! If any spot isn’t taken by a person when the game beings, then it is filled in by the computer. Use the foot pedal to activate a Nitro boost, but use it wisely to keep your advantage. Bonus coins are awarded based upon your finish spot; collect the most and walk away with the most tickets. A dual camera system will also show player faces as avatars in the game

name: Infinity Blade FX
desc: Infinity Blade FX brings fantasy RPG action back to the arcade! Based on the popular mobile game Infinity Blade, this game features gorgeous visuals powered by EPIC’s Unreal Engine 3, all controlled using the large multi-touch screen. Players use basic finger swipe moves to spar with a variety of challenging opponents. You can attack, parry, dodge or block against the various minions as you advance your way towards the sinister God-King and the Infinity Blade. You can also upgrade your skills, weapons and armor to make your quest more exciting and worth playing over and over again.

name: Jetpack Joyride Arcade
desc:
Another popular app lands in the arcade thanks to Adrenaline Amusements!

In Jetpack Joyride, players “suit up” for the coolest jetpack ride ever, taking to the skies as “Barry Steakfries”. Barry’s goal is to collect as many coins as he can using his fancy new jetpack on horizontally scrolling levels for points or tickets. With the exclusive to arcade jetpack vibration seat and 42″ screen, the arcade version of this game goes well beyond the fun you experienced with this game on mobile!

name: NFS Heat TakeDown Arcade
desc: NFS Heat Takedown is a highly modified version of Need For Speed (NFS) Heat that launched to consoles not long ago. Changes have been made to better fit with the needs of the arcade, making it a more streamlined experience. I also have to mention another reason you’ll want to play this on an arcade cabinet in case you’re thinking “well that’s on console” – the sound system on this is the best out of all the racers that I played at IAAPA, and there were quite a few. The base effect+surround was done much better than you usually find in a racer and that alone makes for a fun and more unique experience than you get with racing on your couch or even a gaming chair at home. The rest of the cabinet is cool too, it using an LED billboard as the marquee as a kind of wink at what Raw Thrills did with Fast & Furious.

name: Rabbids Hollywood Arcade (multiguns)
desc:
Are you a sharpshooter? Compete with buddies to stop the Rabbids invasion of Hollywood. Shoot all the crazy creatures during a four-player adventure and explore 3 different movie sets. Warning: comes with edgy humor and never-ending fun! Created in partnership with Ubisoft and features the popular Rabbids: 14M video games sold, 230 TV episodes, and more than 1B online views.

4-Player shooting game
3 Rabbidized movie settings
Never-ending fun!

name: Rampage
desc: The destruction began in 1986 when Midway released Rampage to arcades and subsequently home consoles. Then in 2018, the arcade classic became the most destructive film of 2018. Now you can enjoy the building smashing mutant excitement at the arcade once more with Adrenaline’s RAMPAGE. Combining elements from the recent film and the classic game makes for one of the most intense and exciting destructive experiences to land in arcades in modern times. Players can control one of three mutant monsters: George (the ape), Ralph (the wolf) or Lizzy (the reptile). The controls are simple: a joystick for movement, a button for smashing. The goal is to flatten the buildings as quickly as possible, moving on to the next section and avoiding getting hit by the firepower from the military. You earn points – and tickets – as you progress. How far can a mutant make it?

name: Shooty Skies
desc:
Shooty Skies is an endless arcade flyer from the creators of Crossy Road.
Take to the skies for an endless-arcade shooter that is fast, furious and formidable!
*Collect over 200 daring pilots over 20 different terrains.
*Change the intensity from Scouty to Screamy, if you dare!
*Earn a multitude of achievements
*Challenging daily missions
*Guns! Missiles! Badgers!
Get flying now!

name: Spider-Man: Homecoming (Amd only)
desc: Spider-Man: Homecoming is an “endless runner” style game in which the player controls Spider-Man against the Vulture. Run or websling along a path until confronting the Vulture. He can be beaten via button taps, and the player can win the ticket/coupon jackpot. The cabinet has a colorful design that departs from Adrenaline’s usual style and it supports 2 players at the same time.

name: Tomb Raider Arcade (multiguns)
desc:
In the Tomb Raider Arcade game, Lara Croft moves from the gaming console to a giant 120” arcade game. Tomb Raider Arcade is an intense 4-Player game where players test their skills through 3 chapters with 5 sections each. Based on the character from the hugely success console game and movie franchise.

Team up with other players and battle against increasingly difficult waves of enemies and push your limits to the very edge!
